description: Patton gate: asks before a tool call changes a file that existed when the session started, enforces the mission limits set in its configuration, and, when turned on, has a blind verifier check the change before the agent may stop.

hooks.command: { command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))' >/dev/null 2>&1; } || { printf '%s\n' 'Patton gate: python3 3.10 or newer is not on PATH, so the gate cannot check this call and blocks it. Install python3 3.10 or newer, or turn the gate off with: claude plugin disable patton-gate@patton-protocol' >&2; exit 2; }; exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/patton_gate.py"
